svg.title: Same scene, same bytes — two token sets
svg.desc: The same teaching Meteogram rendered twice from one scene. The left panel uses the package's default tokens; the right panel resolves the same markup with surface, ink, temperature, and halo tokens overridden to a dark club palette. The scene geometry of both panels is identical.

svg.aria-label: Meteogram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10:00 to 19:00 (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.

Meteogram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10:00 to 19:00 (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
